security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Copy JASP tables as APA 7 tables
bundle.longDescription: jAPAsp opens a saved JASP file and turns every results table into an APA 7 table that you can paste into Word or Google Docs.
